race.description: Bracken Ridge Tavern Summer Scorcher Series Race Hcp (C2)
race.comment: ON THE CLOCK (2) chased gamely into the placings second-up at Eagle Farm behind what looks like an above-average one in Wootten Hyde. Looks ready to peak third-up and is drawn to get all the favours. WAX ON WAX OFF (10) rates one of the main dangers after missing by a lip here last week. Backs up quickly and has enough early toe to offset the wide draw. TREVATT COURT (9) resumes off a close Deagon trial and brings a reliable profile at this venue, having missed by less than a length at her final run before a spell. SEVEN OCEANS (11) returns and makes her stable debut for the Heathcote camp. Never really got going in two runs last campaign but did show some encouraging signs in Vic and has trialled well at Doomben in readiness. Will pay to watch for a market push.
